script_note: Search with bundled REST first; on error or empty results, try an already-installed gh using its existing settings; if it also returns no candidates, use site:github.com. For source files prefer an existing route snapshot, shallow Git snapshot, official archive, known-path raw, then limited REST Contents. Git clone is skipped when the reported repository size exceeds 512000 KiB and blobs above 8 MB use raw/REST fallback. repo uses REST README Contents as a light-read shortcut; source route provenance should come from a snapshot or selected-file path. GITHUB_TOKEN/GH_TOKEN are optional and the REST adapter is anonymous by default.
source_requirement: Source-level claims require reading selected repository files, tests, dependencies, and relevant project records; the Agent interprets fetched content. Shallow Git snapshots are limited to repositories reported at 512000 KiB and omit blobs over 8 MB; archives are capped at 64 MB compressed, 256 MB extracted, 20,000 files, and 8 MB per file; raw files are capped at 8 MB. REST responses cap at 8 MB, file text at 40,000 characters, and tree output at 5,000 entries. For deep reads, reuse one temporary snapshot per repository, perform repeated local reads, and remove it at route end.
agent_rule: One GitHub Agent uses the bundled route at every depth. Reuse one temporary snapshot per repository in deep routes and clean it at route end. gh and GITHUB_TOKEN/GH_TOKEN are optional; report the actual source path and any fallback or evidence gap.
